notes: Atrium v0.11.0 — The Thaw: stops the sporadic all-shells freeze, reopens a restarted shell where you were working (not /), adds clickable terminal hyperlinks (OSC 8 + bare URLs) plus a WebGL repaint fix, opens Git Bash in the project directory, remembers the active pane per project across switches, and lightens Atrium's WSL2 footprint (active-scoped polling + staggered spawns) with an honest heavy-WSL usage note.
